scope: Ordinary unit0 parentless anonymous classes mixed with plain empty named declarations inside direct root or valid namespace-body noarg by-value untyped named functions. Function-body named classes consume one RTD key even when never published; anonymous names exist before calls. Runtime publication follows call order, guarded repeats preserve one publication and fresh defaults, and qualified lexical method namespaces survive caller switches. Named Closure, nested and function-in-block placements remain unsupported.
